verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides rosbag recording/playback (ros2-docs-17, ros2-docs-23) which supports collecting robot data for later use, but there is no evidence of any built-in or documented pathway for feeding that data into model training or deploying updated models back to a robot fleet. missing for 10: model-training integration, fleet-wide model deployment/update mechanism, MLOps tooling, and any end-to-end example connecting bag data to a training loop and redeployment.
